{{MissingInfo|1|enva}} [[File:Goneff.png|thumb|250px|Goneff]] '''Goneff''' (Japanese: '''怪盗ゴローニャ''' ''Mysterious Thief {{tt|Golonya|Golem}}'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP192|The Wayward Wobbuffet]]''. He is a master thief who robs banks, leaving nothing behind. During a race to retrieve the key around {{TP|Jessie|Wobbuffet}}'s neck, which was needed to release [[Ash's Pikachu]] from the indestructible PokéPod, Wobbuffet accidentally jumped onto Goneff's escape truck during an ongoing police pursuit. Goneff used the windscreen wipers to knock Wobbuffet off the truck, but this failed. He soon found himself surrounded by [[Officer Jenny]] and her fellow officers. Goneff tried to escape with his backup {{p|Golem}} hot-air balloon, but Wobbuffet accidentally knocked him out of it and into the hands of the police. Later, Goneff escaped this time on a stolen police motorcycle. However, Wobbuffet landed in the sidecar following a freak speedboat crash. Goneff decided to take Wobbuffet hostage, tying him with rope and holing him up in a nearby abandoned building. After Goneff was surrounded by the police, Team Rocket tried to make a deal with him, offering their escape tunnel in exchange for Wobbuffet. However, he refused and used Golem to attack the trio and later [[Ash's Totodile]] when he also confronted him. Totodile hid behind Wobbuffet to avoid Golem's {{m|Tackle}}, prompting Wobbuffet to use {{m|Counter}} to protect himself. The reflected attack hurled both Goneff and Golem into the hands of officers waiting outside. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|1|java|scope=section}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Goneff |pkmn=Golem |type1=Rock |type2=Ground |img=Goneff Golem.png |epnum=EP192 |epname=The Wayward Wobbuffet |vajp= |vaen=Eric Stuart |desc=Goneff has a {{p|Golem}}, which he uses for his schemes. When {{TRT}} got into Goneff's hideaway building to retrieve [[Jessie's Wobbuffet]] that Goneff unintentionally kidnapped, he sent Golem out, only to be confronted shortly thereafter by {{Ash}} and {{AP|Totodile}}, who hit it with a {{m|Water Gun}}. Golem then used Double Team, creating three doubles of itself. It nearly defeated Totodile, but Wobbuffet used {{m|Counter}} on an incoming attack from Golem, sending it flying towards Goneff. Golem and its Trainer were then arrested as a result. Golem's known moves are {{m|Tackle}}, {{m|Double Team}}, and {{m|Dynamic Punch}}.}} ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{rock color}}|bordercolor={{ground color light}} |ja=池田勝 ''Masaru Ikeda'' |it=Oliviero Corbetta |ar=جهاد الأطرش ''Jihad Al Attrash'' |es_eu=Mario Martín |pt_br=Ivo Roberto |pl=Jacek Kałucki}} ==Trivia== * Goneff is {{wp|Yiddish}} for thief. * In the English dub, he speaks with an imitated Russian accent and grammar errors Russian speakers are purported to make.
